ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you ask a boy how old he is? (1 mark)
   A. kayfa haaluka?
   B. kam ʿumruka?
   C. ayna l-kitaab?
   D. maa ismuka?

2. What does the Arabic word مَرْحَبًا (marhaban) mean? (1 mark)
   A. and upon you peace (the reply)
   B. good morning (the reply)
   C. hello
   D. I

3. How is the Arabic word اسْمِي read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. wa ʿalaykumu s-salaam
   B. sabaahu n-nuur
   C. anaa bi-khayr
   D. ismii

4. Which sentence means 'I have a brother and a sister'? (1 mark)
   A. ummii tatbukhu
   B. haadhaa abii
   C. man haadhihi?
   D. ʿindii akh wa ukht

5. Which question do you ask when you point to a boy and want to know who he is? (1 mark)
   A. kayfa haaluka?
   B. man haadhaa?
   C. maa ismuka?
   D. man haadhihi?

6. What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ أُمِّي mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a brother and a sister.
   B. This is my mother.
   C. My father works.
   D. This is my father.

7. What does the Arabic word طَاوِلَةٌ (taawila) mean? (1 mark)
   A. table
   B. cat
   C. pen
   D. chair

8. Which Arabic word means "sit down"? (1 mark)
   A. اِقْرَأْ
   B. اِسْمَعْ
   C. اجْلِسْ
   D. افْتَحِ الْبَابَ

9. How is the Arabic word افْتَحِ الْبَابَ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ukhruj
   B. ismaʿ
   C. iftahi l-baab
   D. ilmis anfaka

10. What does the Arabic sentence عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Blessed festival (Happy Eid).
   B. Happy birthday.
   C. May you be well every year.
   D. Do you have a party? (to a boy)

11. Which Arabic sentence means "Happy birthday." (1 mark)
   A. هَلْ عِنْدَكَ حَفْلَةٌ؟
   B. عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ
   C. كُلَّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِخَيْرٍ
   D. عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ

12. Why are special occasions important for a community? (1 mark)
   A. They are only for children
   B. They are only for the rich
   C. They bring people together and help them to live in peace
   D. They make people quarrel

13. Which Arabic sentence means "I like bananas." (1 mark)
   A. أَشْرَبُ الْمَاءَ
   B. أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ
   C. آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ
   D. أُحِبُّ الْعَصِيرَ

14. Which Arabic word means "touch your nose"? (1 mark)
   A. اِقْرَأْ
   B. أَغْمِضْ عَيْنَيْكَ
   C. اُخْرُجْ
   D. اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ

15. How is the Arabic word رِجْلٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. rijl
   B. raqaba
   C. sinn
   D. dhahr

16. How is the Arabic word أَغْلِقِ الْبَابَ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. aghliqi l-baab
   B. uktub
   C. ukhruj
   D. aghmiD ʿaynayka

17. Which Arabic sentence means "Thank you for listening." (1 mark)
   A. أَنَا فِي الصَّفِّ الرَّابِعِ
   B. فِي بَيْتِي مَطْبَخٌ
   C. آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ
   D. شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ

18. Which of these is true about the Arabic alphabet? (1 mark)
   A. It is read from left to right
   B. It has capital and small letters
   C. It has only 20 letters
   D. It has no capital letters

19. Which sound is made at the back of the throat like the ch in the Scottish word 'loch'? (1 mark)
   A. b (ب)
   B. s (س)
   C. kh (خ)
   D. m (م)

20. Which sound does the Arabic letter ث make? (1 mark)
   A. kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch
   B. th as in think
   C. d as in dog
   D. j as in jug

21. What is blending? (1 mark)
   A. Spelling backwards
   B. Writing a letter
   C. Joining syllables or sounds together to read a word
   D. Drawing a picture

22. What does the Arabic sentence أُسَاعِدُ أُمِّي يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I visit my grandmother on Friday.
   B. I like juice.
   C. I read a book on Sunday.
   D. I help my mother on Saturday.

23. Which question word means 'who'? (1 mark)
   A. ayna
   B. kam
   C. man
   D. limaadhaa

24. How is the Arabic word أُغْنِيَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ughniya
   B. taʿaam
   C. shamʿa
   D. sharaab

25. What does the Arabic sentence الْعَصِيرُ بَارِدٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Water is useful (good for you).
   B. The fish is delicious.
   C. I like food.
   D. The juice is cold.

26. What are verbal cues? (1 mark)
   A. The number of pages
   B. Intonation, speed and tonal variation
   C. The colour of the page
   D. The size of letters

27. What does as-samaku ladhiidh mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like fish.
   B. The fish is delicious.
   C. Where is the fish?
   D. The fish is cold.

28. Which Arabic word means "head"? (1 mark)
   A. سِنٌّ
   B. رَأْسٌ
   C. أُذُنٌ
   D. فَمٌ

29. What does qawiyy mean? (1 mark)
   A. hot
   B. small
   C. strong
   D. new

30. What does the Arabic sentence الشَّمْسُ فِي السَّمَاءِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sun is in the sky.
   B. And the rain is from the sky.
   C. In the room there is a bed.
   D. How beautiful the environment is!

31. What is the name of the Arabic letter د? (1 mark)
   A. Haa
   B. Saad
   C. khaa
   D. daal

32. How many letters are in السبت (as-sabt) including alif and laam? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 3
   C. 5
   D. 6

33. Which two letters begin the names of the days of the week in Arabic script (the word 'the')? (1 mark)
   A. alif and laam
   B. baa and taa
   C. siin and shiin
   D. miim and nuun

34. Which Arabic word means "Thursday"? (1 mark)
   A. الْخَمِيسُ
   B. مَدْرَسَةٌ
   C. الْأَرْبِعَاءُ
   D. الْجُمُعَةُ

35. Which Arabic word means "my turn"? (1 mark)
   A. دَوْرِي
   B. بَالُونٌ
   C. عِيدٌ
   D. صَدِيقٌ

36. Which is a fault in handwriting? (1 mark)
   A. Correct dots
   B. Even spaces between words
   C. Letters on the baseline
   D. Wide gaps inside a word

37. What does the Arabic word طَمَاطِمُ (tamaatim) mean? (1 mark)
   A. water
   B. salt
   C. fruit
   D. tomatoes

38. Which Arabic word means "ear"? (1 mark)
   A. شَعْرٌ
   B. رَقَبَةٌ
   C. أُذُنٌ
   D. جِسْمٌ

39. How does rain help people? (1 mark)
   A. It makes crops die
   B. It has no use
   C. It stops all farming
   D. It helps crops to grow and gives us water

40. Which Arabic word means "beside"? (1 mark)
   A. أُمٌّ
   B. بِجَانِبِ
   C. رِجْلٌ
   D. قَوِيٌّ

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Complete the word شُكْ_ا with the missing letter and give its meaning. (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Translate into English: al-jawwu mumtir (2 marks)

43. Translate into English: ʿalaa t-taawilati kaʿka (2 marks)

44. Give two ways of keeping household items safe. (2 marks) (2 marks)

45. Explain why it is important to know the days of the week. (2 marks) (2 marks)

46. Name three things that make Arabic writing different from English writing. (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Give two ways of taking care of your body. (2 marks) (2 marks)

48. Explain why writing the dots correctly is important. Give one example of two letters that differ only by dots. (3 marks) (3 marks)

49. Give two polite words for interrupting or inviting someone to speak, with meanings. (2 marks) (2 marks)

50. Introduce yourself in Arabic (English letters are fine) with your name, that you are a pupil and that you are from Kenya, then give the English meaning. (4 marks) (4 marks)

51. Translate into English: raʾsii kabiir (2 marks)

52. Name the four marks (harakat) that show short vowels or no vowel and say what each one shows. (4 marks) (4 marks)

53. Write four weather words in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)

54. Translate into English: yadii Sagiira (2 marks)

55. Translate into English: anaa min Kiiniya (2 marks)

56. Translate into English: kulla ʿaamin wa-antum bi-khayr (2 marks)

57. Describe how to carry out a dictation of the days of the week in pairs. (3 marks) (3 marks)

58. Translate into English: wal-maTaru mina s-samaa'i (2 marks)

59. Write five words about a celebration in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

60. Write five members of the family in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

61. Translate into English: al-asdiqaa'u fii l-hafla. (2 marks) (2 marks)

62. Write three body parts in Arabic sounds with meanings. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — kam ʿumruka?
   kam means 'how many' and ʿumruka means 'your age', so kam ʿumruka? asks 'How old are you?'.

2. C — hello
   مَرْحَبًا (marhaban) means hello.

3. D — ismii
   اسْمِي is read ismii and means my name is.

4. D — ʿindii akh wa ukht
   ʿindii means 'I have', akh is brother, wa is 'and' and ukht is sister.

5. B — man haadhaa?
   haadhaa means 'this' for a boy or man. haadhihi is used for a girl or woman.

6. B — This is my mother.
   هَذِهِ أُمِّي (haadhihi ummii) means: This is my mother.

7. A — table
   طَاوِلَةٌ (taawila) means table.

8. C — اجْلِسْ
   اجْلِسْ (ijlis) means sit down.

9. C — iftahi l-baab
   افْتَحِ الْبَابَ is read iftahi l-baab and means open the door.

10. A — Blessed festival (Happy Eid).
   عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ (ʿiid mubaarak) means: Blessed festival (Happy Eid).

11. D — عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ
   عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ (ʿiid miilaad saʿiid) means: Happy birthday.

12. C — They bring people together and help them to live in peace
   Celebrations bring families and friends together and build unity.

13. B — أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ
   أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ (uhibbu l-mawza) means: I like bananas.

14. D — اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ
   اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ (ilmis anfaka) means touch your nose.

15. A — rijl
   رِجْلٌ is read rijl and means leg.

16. A — aghliqi l-baab
   أَغْلِقِ الْبَابَ is read aghliqi l-baab and means close the door.

17. D — شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ
   شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ (shukran li-istimaaʿikum) means: Thank you for listening.

18. D — It has no capital letters
   Arabic has one style for each letter and no capitals.

19. C — kh (خ)
   The letter khaa makes the throat sound kh.

20. B — th as in think
   The letter ث makes the sound th as in think.

21. C — Joining syllables or sounds together to read a word
   Blending means saying the sounds one after another and joining them into a word.

22. D — I help my mother on Saturday.
   أُسَاعِدُ أُمِّي يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ (usaaʿidu ummii yawma s-sabt) means: I help my mother on Saturday.

23. C — man
   man means who. ayna means where, kam means how many and limaadhaa means why.

24. A — ughniya
   أُغْنِيَةٌ is read ughniya and means song.

25. D — The juice is cold.
   الْعَصِيرُ بَارِدٌ (al-ʿasiiru baarid) means: The juice is cold.

26. B — Intonation, speed and tonal variation
   Verbal cues are the ways the voice shows meaning.

27. B — The fish is delicious.
   samak is fish and ladhiidh means delicious.

28. B — رَأْسٌ
   رَأْسٌ (raʾs) means head.

29. C — strong
   qawiyy means strong.

30. A — The sun is in the sky.
   الشَّمْسُ فِي السَّمَاءِ (ash-shamsu fii s-samaa'i) means: The sun is in the sky.

31. D — daal
   The letter د is called daal.

32. C — 5
   The letters are alif, laam, siin, baa and taa.

33. A — alif and laam
   al- is written with alif and laam.

34. A — الْخَمِيسُ
   الْخَمِيسُ (al-khamiis) means Thursday.

35. A — دَوْرِي
   دَوْرِي (dawrii) means my turn.

36. D — Wide gaps inside a word
   Wide gaps inside a word make it look like several words.

37. D — tomatoes
   طَمَاطِمُ (tamaatim) means tomatoes.

38. C — أُذُنٌ
   أُذُنٌ (udhun) means ear.

39. D — It helps crops to grow and gives us water
   Rain waters crops and fills rivers and tanks.

40. B — بِجَانِبِ
   بِجَانِبِ (bijaanibi) means beside.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: شُكْرًا: the missing letter is raa (ر). It means thank you.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the letter and 1 mark for the meaning.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: The weather is rainy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: On the table there is a cake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep the key in a safe place such as the cupboard; keep knives out of reach of small children; keep lamps away from water.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each safe way.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Days help us to plan what to do and to use time well, for example school, homework and rest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for planning and 1 mark for good use of time.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is written from right to left; it has no capital letters; most letters join and change shape; short vowels are shown with marks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid difference.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands and face; clean teeth; eat good food; sleep well.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible way.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: A wrong dot changes the letter and the word. For example ف has one dot above and ق has two dots above.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for changes the letter, 1 mark for changes the word, 1 mark for a correct example.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: ʿafwan (excuse me) and tafaddal (please, go ahead).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with meaning.

50. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: ismii Wanjiku. anaa tilmiidha. anaa min Kiiniya. My name is Wanjiku. I am a pupil. I am from Kenya.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for the meaning.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: My head is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: fatHa gives a, kasra gives i, Damma gives u, and sukuun shows no vowel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mark and its meaning.

53. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example shams (sun), matar (rain), riih (wind), sahaab (clouds).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: My hand is small.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am from Kenya.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: May you be well every year.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: One learner says a day; the other repeats it, says the sounds and writes the letters from right to left; they check and correct together.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying the day, 1 mark for writing and 1 mark for checking.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: And the rain is from the sky.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

59. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example ʿiid (festival), hafla (party), hadiyya (gift), baaluun (balloon), kaʿka (cake).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

60. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example ab (father), umm (mother), akh (brother), ukht (sister), jadd (grandfather).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: The friends are at the party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 'the friends' and 1 mark for 'at the party'.

62. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example raʾs (head), yad (hand), fam (mouth).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.
